component.name: Space Cadet Pinball
component.summary: Game engine for Space Cadet Pinball

description.p: Reverse engineering of '3D Pinball for Windows - Space Cadet', a game bundled with Windows.

ul.li: Native .deb (Debian/Ubuntu) and .rpm (Fedora/openSUSE) packages, built with CPack.
A build-packages.sh script to produce them locally.
The release workflow now builds and publishes all formats (AppImage, .deb, .rpm, archives, Windows zip, macOS dmg).
An AppImage is built for Linux, so the game can be run without installing it.
The in-game version string matches the release again; it had been stuck at 2.1.1.
MSVC builds compile again, which also unbreaks the documented Windows release path.
A Windows installer (NSIS) with shortcuts, an Add/Remove Programs entry and an uninstaller.
Windows release builds for x86 and x64, produced by CI.
A SoundFont shipped next to the executable is used automatically, so packaged builds work without configuration.
Control bindings are migrated once when upgrading from the SDL2-based build.
The menu bar no longer swallows mouse clicks meant for the flippers.
The game no longer spins a CPU core while its window is unfocused.
Replaced SDL2 with GLFW for windowing and input, and with Vulkan for rendering.
Replaced SDL2_mixer with a built-in miniaudio software mixer.
MIDI music is rendered by FluidSynth with a General MIDI SoundFont (optional).

description.p: Feature release focusing on FT compatibility.

ul.li: FT: collision system changes, table control changes, multiball, three MIDI tracks.
Work in progress: localization support. Depends on external font selection for most languages.
HW accelerated ImGui renderer.
Experimental stereo sound support.
UX improvements.
Bug fixes.

description.p: First bug fix release of cross-platform port.

ul.li: Improved Linux support: install target, icons, desktop shortcut, alternative data paths.
Improved game controller support.
High precision sleep mode for ~0 frame time jitter.
Integer image scaling mode.
3DPB <-> FT data switch option, for easier data-set changes when both are available.
FT demo data support.
Bug fixes.
Windows dependencies removed.
Graphics and sounds rendered with SDL.
Dear ImGui GUI.
CMake build script, compiles on a lot of platforms.
A number of 3rd party source ports.

description.p: All features of v1.x are present, except for text translations.
Development and releases of v1.x will continue, don’t confuse the two. All source ports are technically v2.0RC, not v1.x.
There are no Linux or macOS binaries attached, compile them yourself.
This release was made better with the help of contributors. I thank them for their interest in the project.
